notes.title: Ages of Mages: The last keeper 1.0 released!
notes.content:
After two years, nearly 20 Early Access updates. Ages of Mages: The last keeper has now been released!

 Check this out!
https://youtu.be/GICi8gXySOQ

We would like to thank everyone who has brought the game, thank everyone who give us feedbacks, you made it with us! We really that hope you enjoy it! 



 Update details: 

--- Improve: Frame rate Optimized.
--- Added: New language - Italian. 
Special thanks: ashram1 

--- Change: Achievement "STGlord", "No Injured 30 minuts" changes to "20 minuts".
--- Change: Achievement "Liberator", "Rescue all soldiers" changes to "Rescue 18 soldiers".
--- Change: Stage "Dark Maze" more easier now.

 Thank you! 

Yours,
YFC games
